# `adt package`

ABAP package operations

```bash
adt package [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                | Description                                                  |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt package package`  | Get details about a specific ABAP package                    |
| `adt package create`   | Create a new ABAP package                                    |
| `adt package list`     | List objects and subpackages in an ABAP package              |
| `adt package delete`   | Delete an ABAP package                                       |
| `adt package activate` | Activate one or more ABAP packages                           |
| `adt package stat`     | Check if an ABAP package exists (exit 0=found, 10=not found) |

## `adt package package`

Get details about a specific ABAP package

```bash
adt package package [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description             | Default |
| -------- | ----------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | Package name to inspect |         |

**Options**

| Option              | Description                              | Default |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--json`            | Output as JSON                           | `false` |
| `--objects`         | List objects in the package              |         |
| `--no-sub-packages` | Exclude subpackages when listing objects |         |

## `adt package create`

Create a new ABAP package

```bash
adt package create [options] <name> <description>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument        | Description                 | Default |
| --------------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>`        | Package name (e.g., ZMYPKG) |         |
| `<description>` | Package description         |         |

**Options**

| Option                      | Description                            | Default |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-s, --super-package <pkg>` | Parent (super) package name            |         |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>`  | Transport request number               |         |
| `--no-error-existing`       | Do not error if package already exists |         |
| `--json`                    | Output result as JSON                  |         |

## `adt package list`

List objects and subpackages in an ABAP package

```bash
adt package list [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                 | Default |
| -------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | Package name (e.g., ZMYPKG) |         |

**Options**

| Option               | Description                                           | Default |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-r, --recursive`    | Include objects from subpackages recursively          |         |
| `-l, --long`         | Long output — include object type and package columns |         |
| `--subpackages-only` | List only subpackages, not objects                    |         |
| `--json`             | Output as JSON                                        |         |

## `adt package delete`

Delete an ABAP package

```bash
adt package delete [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description                 | Default |
| -------- | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | Package name (e.g., ZMYPKG) |         |

**Options**

| Option                     | Description              | Default |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------- |
| `-t, --transport <corrnr>` | Transport request number |         |
| `-y, --yes`                | Skip confirmation prompt |         |
| `--json`                   | Output result as JSON    |         |

## `adt package activate`

Activate one or more ABAP packages

```bash
adt package activate [options] <names...>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument     | Description                 | Default |
| ------------ | --------------------------- | ------- |
| `<names...>` | Package name(s) to activate |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description           | Default |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output result as JSON |         |

## `adt package stat`

Check if an ABAP package exists (exit 0=found, 10=not found)

```bash
adt package stat [options] <name>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description           | Default |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `<name>` | Package name to check |         |

**Options**

| Option   | Description           | Default |
| -------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `--json` | Output result as JSON |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
